entry.title: New: Bill 59 (2024) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, APPENDIX A, PART I, DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING AND HUMAN CONCERNS, FEDERAL DISASTER RELIEF GRANT FUNDS" The purpose of this bill is to amend the Fiscal Year 2024 Budget Appendix A, Part I, Department of Housing and Human Concerns, to add a new appropriation for Federal Disaster Relief Grant Funds in the amount of $1,081,528.
